subject.title: [Feature]: Memory/Context Improvements (metrics + global semantic search + conversation chaining + preload on restart)

question: Should this remain the canonical umbrella, or should the remaining metrics, session-memory policy, continuation, and restart-warmup behavior be split into separately owned issues?
rationale: The remaining requests require choices about API visibility, privacy boundaries, configuration defaults, costs, and gateway lifecycle semantics that automation cannot safely select.

options.title: Split into narrow issues
options.body: Designate one canonical issue for each remaining contract and retain this umbrella only until those links preserve its context.

options.title: Keep the umbrella
options.body: Continue using this issue as the cross-area design tracker while requiring separately approved implementation pull requests.

options.title: Limit core scope
options.body: Pursue only missing generic plugin or hook seams and leave optional memory or analytics behavior to plugins.

recommendation.title: Split into narrow issues
recommendation.body: Designate one canonical issue for each remaining contract and retain this umbrella only until those links preserve its context.

likelyOwner.reason: This person has the strongest available history across the memory, usage, startup, and session surfaces and authored the existing keep-open review context.
